text: The Public Investment Fund's 2024 consolidated financial statements list Lean Company for Business Services among its subsidiaries, with a 100% ownership interest.
short: PIF owns 100% of Lean Business Services

source.name: Public Investment Fund: Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (archived copy of pif.gov.sa PDF), note 40 (list of subsidiaries)
source.quote: Lean Company for Business Services Information Technology 100.00%  100.00%
